# D365 FnO MCP Server (Repository Summary)

This repo contains a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that indexes a Microsoft Dynamics 365
Finance & Operations (D365 FnO) `PackagesLocalDirectory` and exposes grounded tools over
Streamable HTTP.

## Start here

- Repo + agent guide: `AGENTS.md`
- Full README + config table: `README.md`
- Agent-centric install steps: `llms-install.md`
- Operator docs (hosted deployments): `docs/hosted-deployment.md`
- User/admin workflows: `docs/user-and-admin-guide.md`
- Local agent definitions (Copilot/Claude): `docs/local-agents.md`
- Hybrid gateway (hosted standard index + local custom index): `docs/hybrid-gateway.md`

## Repo map (high level)

- `src/index.ts`: CLI entry (`serve`, `gateway`, `index`, `doctor`, `setup`, `artifact`, ...)
- `src/server/`: MCP server + HTTP transport + API key auth + hosted startup
- `src/indexer/`: scan/parse AOT XML + build SQLite index + optional importers
- `src/tools/`: MCP tool handlers (metadata, labels, security, traces, generators, ...)
- `src/gateway/`: the `gateway` command: loopback MCP endpoint that indexes only the custom models
  locally, forwards to the hosted server and merges both (`router.ts` routes, `strategies/` merges)
- `tests/`: vitest
- `agents/`: prebuilt agent profiles (edit `agents/source/`, then run `npm run build:agents`)

## Common commands

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm test

# CLI (compiled)
npm run start -- doctor
npm run start -- index
npm run start -- serve

# Local gateway in front of a hosted server (needs D365_HOSTED_MCP_URL, a hosted API key and
# D365_CUSTOM_METADATA_DIR; see docs/hybrid-gateway.md)
npm run gateway
```

## Guardrails

- This project is read-only by default; write tools require `D365_ENABLE_WRITE_TOOLS=1` and are
  refused in hosted mode.
- Do not invent AOT names; resolve against the index and report unresolved items.
- Gateway code (`src/gateway/`) must never import `src/config.ts` (it validates the server's
  environment eagerly and exits the process); use `src/gateway/config.ts`.
- Custom code must not be forwarded upstream: the gateway sends the hosted server only the caller's
  tool arguments, never anything read from the local index or from custom files.
